- **Next.js Version**: 16.1.1 (supports App Router with native SpeedInsights integration)
- **Router Type**: App Router
- **Component Location**: Root layout (app/layout.tsx)
- **Package Manager**: npm

The implementation follows Vercel's best practices for Next.js 13.5+ with App Router:
- Using the optimized `/next` export which automatically tracks route changes
- No additional configuration required - the component will automatically track Core Web Vitals
- Positioned at the root layout level to ensure tracking across all pages

✅ Build completed successfully without errors
✅ Linting passed with no errors in the modified file
